title: Wrong-ID guesses are limited for IPv6 too, a name is never shown to someone who only typed an ID, and a draw being made cannot be voided by closing the account
changes: Someone typing wrong employee IDs is now stopped after 30 tries even if their internet line changes its address on every try (a whole IPv6 line now counts as one visitor), and after 500 wrong tries on one game from anywhere

Typing an employee ID that is on your list no longer shows the person's name. An ID you type is only matched to your list, it is not proof that you are that person, so nothing about the person is shown until you say yes
While a draw is being made, closing your account or deleting the game's data by e-mail is refused until the winners are shown, so nobody can remove entries after the random number is public
The Legal page now says the same true thing about privacy as every other screen: player details are deleted within 24 hours, winners' details are kept for 365 days
Sign-in help and button names now match the sign-in e-mail ("Sign in"), and the last "my" labels you could see ("Create your game", "Back to your game", "Close your partner account") now speak to you
A game saved from an older version that asked for a mobile number now asks for an ID like every other game; a typed mobile number is never a way in

title: Entries stay frozen on every path, a stuck payment notice can be repeated, and organizer screens speak to you
changes: Once the list of entries is closed, you can no longer delete a person, delete everybody, un-bind a card, send a card link again or cancel the game until the winners are shown, so nobody can change who is in the draw after the random number is public
A payment notice that stopped half way can now be repeated: the game finishes the order on the console's next try instead of waiting for ever
Everything you read as an organizer or Host now speaks to you: the console, the sign-in mail and the agreement boxes say "you", never "I" or "my"
Going live fails the health check if the test-only open-join switch is set
The fairness sentence you show to players is now checked by a test against what the game really does, including a Start pressed before the start time

title: A fair draw you can check, by invitation only, one true privacy line, and a payment notice that can be repeated safely
changes: The list of entries closes at the draw time (or when you press Start) and cannot change after that: removing or adding someone later does not change the draw
When you press Start, the winners come from a public beacon round that is published after your press, so nobody can see the result before it is made
The scheduled job (every minute) makes the draw even when nobody opens a page
Every game is by invitation only and asks for an ID only; the server refuses "anyone with the link"
One privacy line everywhere: player details are deleted within 24 hours of the draw; the organizer's, hosts' and winners' details are kept for 365 days; invoices as the law requires
The paid notice from the console can be repeated safely if a first try stopped half way
Going live is one step with a health check; the old sign-in and pay routes go away together

title: The Corporate Games look: new website, one logo, six-item menu
changes: Every public page now looks and feels like the Corporate Tambola website: warm colours, the Corporate Lucky Draw badge with CORPORATE above the name, the same header, footer, buttons and fonts
The header menu has six items: How it works, Free demo game, Guide, Brochure, Refer & earn, Log in
New pages: How it works and Guide (the organizer guide); the Brochure is a web page with the one-page PDF to download
One Corporate Games bar at the top of every public page; new app icons, share picture and e-mail header in the same brand
The organizer console and the phone pages wear the same colours, fonts and header bar. Nothing in how the console works has changed
Wording: close group everywhere, shorter plain sentences; the old organizer-guide address points to the Guide

title: A game waiting for payment never blocks a new game
changes: Only drafts that were never published count toward the limit of ten drafts; a game that is published but not yet paid for no longer stops an Organizer or Host from making a new game
Making a copy of a game follows the same rule

title: Bigger daily write guard
changes: The daily database-write guard is raised to 2,000,000 (a runaway guard only), because the account is on the paid Workers plan; a crowd joining together no longer meets a 'very busy' answer from the guard

title: Same hardening as Corporate Tambola 1.3.3: joining, permissions, messages, simpler console
changes: Joining: an employee ID or mobile number is checked against the organizer's list, a stranger waits for the organizer's yes, one phone cannot play as another (device proof on every card action), the same person joining twice gets the same card
A join that gets no answer (slow link, busy moment) is asked again by itself, safe because the same person always gets the same card
Permissions: a Co-host who has not accepted the terms cannot pay, an delete is refused while the game is being played, a Host's narrow link cannot change controls
Simpler console: the rarely used 'How many rounds' choice is hidden, never disabled; one game is one round
A demo link (zc.html?pass=) is used once, also when the console opens straight into a game
Players' data is deleted 20 hours after the end (the promise stays 24 hours) and a lazy tick runs the housekeeping when the scheduled job is late
Every refusal now says what happened, where, and how to fix it (guide catalog)
Big screen shows 'Connection lost' when the public clock does not answer for 15 seconds

title: One-door sign-in and e-mail-first console
changes: One sign-in door for Organizers and Hosts with a six-box code screen
A confirmed Host's e-mail is answered 'exists' (a code is sent)
Console keeps the state of each step

title: Colourful cards, Help Desk, guided errors
changes: Colour and phone-fit work, installable app
Help Desk helper flow
Plain-words errors with a Take-me-there button

title: Corporate Lucky Draw goes live
changes: Lucky Draw on its own Cloudflare stack
Cards for every guest, winners decided by the software from the public numbers
Payment through the central payment service, an e-mail with a link to your report
